changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx_header ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, arrival_id UUID NOT NULL, msg_id_raw VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, msg_id VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, created_ts VARCHAR(14) NOT NULL, tx_count INT NOT NULL, initg_pty VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, business_date VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, client_token VARCHAR(16), layout_version INT NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uq_header_arrival UNIQUE (arrival_id) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx_entry ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, arrival_id UUID NOT NULL, sequence INT NOT NULL, record_type VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, e2e_raw VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, e2e VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, creditor_account VARCHAR(23) NOT NULL, contract_ref VARCHAR(14), currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, amount_raw VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, branch_code VARCHAR(11), debtor_name VARCHAR(35), debtor_account VARCHAR(23), acc_type_seq VARCHAR(8), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uq_entry_arrival_sequence UNIQUE (arrival_id, sequence) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS validation_log ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, arrival_id UUID NOT NULL, sequence INT NOT NULL, outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, detail VARCHAR(256), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uq_validation_arrival_sequence UNIQUE (arrival_id, sequence) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS isr_resp ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, response_file VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, orgnl_msg_id VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, e2e VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(8), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (response_file, e2e) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sbsr_resp ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, response_file VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, orgnl_msg_id VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, e2e VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(8), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (response_file, e2e) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pbsr_resp ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, response_file VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, orgnl_msg_id VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, e2e VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(8), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (response_file, e2e) );

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS ext_tx_status AS SELECT t.arrival_id, t.sequence, t.e2e, h.client_token AS client, COALESCE(p.status, s.status, i.status, CASE WHEN v.outcome = 'PASS' THEN 'CTV_PASS' ELSE v.outcome END) AS status, CASE WHEN p.e2e IS NOT NULL THEN 4 WHEN s.e2e IS NOT NULL THEN 3 WHEN i.e2e IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS stage_rank FROM tx_entry t JOIN tx_header h ON h.arrival_id = t.arrival_id LEFT JOIN validation_log v ON v.arrival_id = t.arrival_id AND v.sequence = t.sequence LEFT JOIN isr_resp i ON i.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN sbsr_resp s ON s.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN pbsr_resp p ON p.e2e = t.e2e;

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prg_watermark ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, client VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, e2e VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, last_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (client, e2e) );
